text:
Type: dark grey metal bell pendant lamp
Use: focused light over a dining table, a kitchen island or a workbench; dining room, kitchen, living room
Style: industrial, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: matte powder-coated steel shade, metal chain with an intertwined black cord, matching steel ceiling plate
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black
Shape: tall bell shade with a straight cylindrical neck flaring to a wide rim, hangs from a link chain, bold and solid, medium visual weight
Feel: robust, urban, moody, graphic
Goes with: concrete, raw wood, black steel, brick walls; industrial lofts, modern kitchens

product.name: HEKTAR
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 400 lumen globe opal white. View more product information This lamp gives a pleasant light for dining and spreads a good directed light across your dining or bar table.
